svg.title: A year of building — brianvarskonst
svg.desc: brianvarskonst's visible GitHub contribution calendar, 2025-10-19 to 2026-10-21: 3,501 contributions across 160 active days. The public calendar can include anonymized private contributions when the profile owner enables them. Each plot represents one date; building height increases with its contribution count, and empty plots represent zero contributions. Roof shades follow GitHub's daily activity levels; windows and rooftop details are decorative. This records contribution activity, not productivity or quality. The crescent moon and stars are fixed decorative details, not astronomical data.

g.text: $ node tools/profile/generate.mjs # one plot per day
